textHint: One line per row, up to 6 lines of 40 letters. Lines are written one after another. Hindi and other languages work too, in your device's font.
textPlaceholder:

backgroundHint: Green screen can be keyed out in most editors, so the writing can sit over your own video. Black works with the Screen blend mode.
bigFirst: Make the first line bigger (a title)
fourKHint: 4K needs a recent computer or phone and takes the longest. The file is large.
keepOpenSmooth: Drawing every frame: {done}% done, about {left} seconds left. Keep this screen on and stay on this page.
keepOpen: Keep this screen on and stay on this page while the video records. It takes as long as the video.
smoothNote: Saved as an MP4 file with every frame drawn, at 30 frames a second.
webmNote: This browser saves WebM video. It plays in Chrome, Edge and Firefox. If an app does not accept it, open this page in Chrome on a computer or a recent Android phone and save again.
noRecord: This browser cannot record video. You can still preview and save a picture. Try a recent Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox to make the video.
failed: The video could not be made. Try 720p, fewer lines or a faster writing speed, and keep this page open while it records.
empty: Type some text above to see it written.
lengthNote: {seconds} seconds, worked out from how much you write and how fast.
tip: Tip: save the video, then drop it into Instagram Edits, CapCut or InShot and add your sound there. A green screen background can be keyed out so the writing sits over your own video.
credit: Letters are drawn by your device and traced into a pen path, so any text and language the font can show works.
